title: Masked summary pipeline for PDF and Word files
prompt: Client details can't go to our AI provider. I need a pipeline where I drop in a PDF or Word document and get back the text with names, email addresses and phone numbers masked, a short summary, and a list of key dates. The masking has to happen on our side before any AI sees the text. A file that can't be read should come back as an error, not kill the run. My Anthropic key is set up. Build it and test it with a sample document.
